description: This file implements the OCIContainer class, which manages container lifecycle operations, event dispatching, and notification registration within a plugin architecture. It interacts with a DobbyInterface for container control and handles events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes, notifying registered observers accordingly.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing container lifecycle, event dispatching, and notification handling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback to receive container events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Submits an event to the worker pool for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches container events to registered notifications based on event type and parameters.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of containers via the Dobby interface.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: PauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: ResumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: HibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with specified options.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source into a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem target from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Handler invoked when a container has started; dispatches the start event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Handler invoked when a container has stopped; dispatches the stop event.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Handler invoked when a container fails; dispatches the failure event.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Handler invoked when a container's state changes; dispatches the state change event.
